lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15 high-luminance blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern on the mid-posterior flank, exhibiting decreasing spatial frequency as the flank tapers towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form identifiable grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance specular highlights on the superior margin and distinct shadow gradients on the inferior margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of faint, high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the base and trailing edge.
